notes.description: A fast rate of light rounds, tight for the first few, then wild. Short bursts win.
notes.range: Best within 15 m: full damage, 7 body shots. Down to 35 % (20 shots) by 35 m; reaches 100 m. Standard ballistics: by impact speed, the same distances.
notes.design: Benchmark C: very high rate of weak rounds, tight for the first few then widening fast, very fast recovery, snappy reload.
notes.model: The owner's own MP5K Style PDW (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json), sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced the 3DModelsCC0 Suomi KP. No stock: held a little ahead of the shoulder, the left hand on its front grip. The kit SMG is the fallback.
